sections.title: Experimental Organic Chemistry B
sections.description: A basic laboratory course in which both the theoretical and practical aspects of a variety of organic reactions and multistep syntheses are emphasized. Modern chromatographic, instrumental, and spectroscopic techniques are applied to experimental organic chemistry. CHEM 2420 is a required co-requisite for CHEM 2452 for Penn undergraduate students. LPS students may take CHEM 2420 (or equivalent) as a pre-requisite or a co-requisite to CHEM 2452.
